source.title: The ECHELON-2 Trial: 5-year results of a randomized, phase III study of brentuximab vedotin with chemotherapy for CD30-positive peripheral T-cell lymphoma
source.source_type: 5-year exploratory follow-up of a randomized, double-blind, phase III active-comparator trial

semantic_spot_checks.claim: CD30 CR strata in AITL and PTCL-NOS
The 5-year update was exploratory/not prespecified and nominal P values were not multiplicity adjusted

source_integrity_findings.location: Results, manuscript page 8, ongoing peripheral neuropathy severity in CHOP arm
source_integrity_findings.finding: The source prints grade counts 30/42, 11/42, and 1/42 with percentages 64%, 23%, and 2%. The counts sum to 42, but the printed percentages do not correspond to those counts and do not sum to 100%.
source_integrity_findings.handling: Preserved as a source-integrity finding; no corrected percentages were substituted.

consistency_review.follow_up_definition_note: The abstract reports median follow-up 47.6 months for the 5-year efficacy estimates, while Results reports median follow-up to last contact 66.8 months (range 0-90). They are retained as different reported follow-up summaries.

protocol_version_note: The governing filename is summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md while its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. Project precedence makes the v4-named file authoritative.
extraction_limitations: Randomization and masking details that the source delegates to the earlier primary ECHELON-2 publication were not reconstructed from that cited paper.
The extraction captures central design, efficacy, safety, biomarker, subsequent-therapy, disclosure, and limitation assertions rather than every baseline characteristic or every forest-plot row.
Bibliographic entries were not atomized; reference processing is audited separately.
The trial was not powered for non-ALCL histologic comparisons, and the CD30 analysis was post hoc and not powered for biomarker-response effects.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer identity is represented in provenance.
